title: The Past Conditional: ha + past tense + volna ('if I had done...')

sections.title: Forming Counterfactuals in the Past
sections.content: To express what would have happened if past circumstances had been different, Hungarian uses the past tense followed by the auxiliary *volna*: *Ha tudtam volna, elmentem volna.* ('If I had known, I would have gone.'). Both the condition clause and the result clause use *múlt idő + volna*.

items.spanish: Ha időben szóltál volna, elkerültük volna ezt a hibát.
items.english: If you had spoken in time, we would have avoided this mistake.

items.spanish: Nem történt volna baj, ha körültekintőbbek lettünk volna.
items.english: No harm would have happened if we had been more cautious.
